results.title: Time to Jump-Start Congress
results.description: Another fortnight has come and gone—and not just any fortnight. Continuing a trend that began in 2015—and mirroring, in the political realm, the ratcheting up of global temperatures and resultant climatic catastrophes—this has been the 290th consecutive fortnight to have been worse than the one before. Appropriately, this one kicked off under cover of darkness. In the early morning hours of Saturday, August 8th, the full Senate voted, in effect, to combine the offices of Attorney General of the United States of America with that of Mr. Fixit of the Trump Organization. results.title: 1969 Porsche 912 Coupe
results.description: This 1969 Porsche 912 coupe was acquired by the seller in 2016 and was repainted in 2018. The car is finished in Medium Ivory over black leatherette upholstery and is powered by a 1.6-liter flat-four mated to a four-speed manual transaxle. Equipment includes 15" Fuchs forged alloy wheels, disc brakes, RS-style door panels, lap and shoulder belts, and a digital AM/FM radio. This 912 coupe is now offered with a car cover and a clean Kentucky title in the seller's name.
